IGUI_BU_ReviveNote: Condition +%1. This battery takes %2 more. Uses some baking soda.

IGUI_BU_SolarTip: One panel makes %1 in clear daylight. Daylight now %2; snow on a panel takes its share. Making at least the load (%3), the panels carry it instead of a generator; short of it, a generator takes over. A running generator keeps running; switch it off to go back to solar.
IGUI_BU_BankNote: Battery racks join: spare power is stored.
IGUI_BU_Reason_rackTier: Battery racks join utility panels of tier 2 and up.
IGUI_BU_BankTip: %1 batteries in %2 racks charge and give power together, keeping %3 of what goes in. Drawn deep they wear faster; each below condition 30 takes 2 percent of the bank a day; below freezing, the cold locks part of it. When they are empty a generator takes over.
IGUI_BU_SolarBankTip: One panel makes %1 in clear daylight. Daylight now %2; snow on a panel takes its share. What they make over the load (%3) charges the batteries; what they lack comes from them. While a generator runs, it all charges them.
IGUI_BU_ControllerNote: Charge controller: hands the load to a generator when the batteries are low, charges them from it, and goes back to them once they are full. No generator starts in quiet hours.
IGUI_BU_ProtectNote: Deep discharge protection: devices that are not essential go off when the batteries are low; they are never drawn below 5 percent.
IGUI_BU_ControllerTip: Charge controller: below %1 it hands the load to a generator and charges the batteries from it meanwhile; at %2 it goes back to them. In quiet hours (%3) it starts no generator, and switches the power off when the batteries are empty.
IGUI_BU_ProtectTip: While the batteries carry the load, below %1 the devices that are not essential go off; they are never drawn below 5 percent.
IGUI_BU_SetStart: Hand over to a generator: below %1
IGUI_BU_Notice_BankLow: %1: the batteries are low; a generator takes over
IGUI_BU_Notice_QuietCut: %1: quiet hours: power off rather than starting a generator
IGUI_BU_Notice_Saving: %1: saving the batteries: %2 devices that are not essential off
IGUI_BU_BlackoutTip: Switches off this panel's light switches and lamps (at tier 4 not those marked essential), so no light draws zombies at night. The switches stay as they are: ending it brings back what was on.
IGUI_BU_BlackoutEndTip: Switches the lights the blackout took back on.
